chunks: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said in the last sermon that he delivered:

"Whoever repents a year before his death, Allah accepts his repentance." Then he said: "Indeed, a year is a long time. Whoever repents a month before his death, Allah accepts his repentance." Then he said: "Indeed, a month is a long time, and whoever repents a week before his death, Allah accepts his repentance." Then he said: "Indeed, a week is a long time, and whoever repents a day before his death, Allah accepts his repentance." Then he said: "And indeed, a day is a long time, and whoever repents an hour before his death, Allah accepts his repentance." Then he said: "And indeed, an hour is a long time, and whoever repents when his soul has reached this—"
And he gestured with his hand to his throat: "Allah accepts his repentance."

key_terms.السَّنَةَ: the year; mentioned as a long period before death
key_terms.بِجُمْعَةٍ: within a week; a shorter period still sufficient for repentance
key_terms.بِسَاعَةٍ: within an hour; even a very short time before death
key_terms.تَابَ: repented; turned back to Allah in sincere repentance
key_terms.حَلْقِهِ: his throat; the place indicated as the final stage before death
key_terms.مَوْتِهِ: his death; the approach of a person's final moment
key_terms.نَفْسُهُ: his soul; referring to the soul reaching the throat at death

ai.seo_question: Until when is repentance accepted before death in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that tawbah remains open for a person until the final moments before death. It emphasizes Allah’s mercy and urges people not to delay repentance, since even a short remaining time can still be sufficient if one sincerely turns back to Him.
